summary_en: This phase II trial tests botensilimab and balstilimab, two immunotherapy drugs given before surgery (neoadjuvant), in patients with high-risk, non-metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Botensilimab is given by IV over 30 minutes on day 1 of weeks 1 and 7, and balstilimab is given by IV over 30 minutes on day 1 of weeks 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, and 11, as long as the disease does not progress and side effects stay acceptable. Patients have a nephrectomy 12 to 16 weeks after starting treatment, and the study evaluates safety and feasibility as stated in the official title.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase II estudia botensilimab y balstilimab, dos medicamentos de inmunoterapia que se administran antes de la cirugía (neoadyuvancia), en pacientes con carcinoma de células renales de tipo células claras de alto riesgo y sin metástasis. El botensilimab se administra por vía intravenosa durante 30 minutos el día 1 de las semanas 1 y 7, y el balstilimab se administra por vía intravenosa durante 30 minutos el día 1 de las semanas 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 y 11, siempre que la enfermedad no progrese y los efectos secundarios sean aceptables. Los pacientes se someten a una nefrectomía entre 12 y 16 semanas después de iniciar el tratamiento, y el estudio evalúa la seguridad y la factibilidad, según se indica en el título oficial.
who_for: Biopsy-confirmed, non-metastatic, high-risk kidney cancer with a clear cell component
Scheduled for partial or radical nephrectomy with curative intent
ECOG performance status of 2 or better (or Karnofsky 60% or higher)
Adequate blood counts, liver, and kidney function as defined in the criteria
not_for: Suspected or proven metastatic renal cell carcinoma
Prior systemic therapy for renal cell carcinoma, or prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, or anti-CTLA-4 treatment
QTcF above 480 ms, congenital long QT syndrome, or significant cardiac arrhythmia
